args.name: page
args.doc: One of the app's main pages, by its name in the sidebar: Dashboard, Employees, Payroll, Payslips, Leave, Reimbursements, Tax, Settings, Help, Setup. Refused with the names when it is not one.

moves.say: {go: Leave} as you take them to one of the app's pages.
moves.doc: Open one of the sidebar's pages and ring its heading.

args.name: thing
args.doc: A part of the screen in front, by the label it shows: a payslip line (Loss of pay, TDS, Net pay), a control (Switch regime, Approve), a panel (Old regime slabs).

moves.say: {show: TDS} at the start of the sentence about that part of the screen; it scrolls into view and is ringed.
moves.doc: Scroll to the data-stage-thing whose label matches and ring it. Refused with the labels on the screen.
Open any screen of the app by its path; ring its heading.

args.name: against
args.doc: The month to compare with, 2025-12; null shows the payslip alone.

moves.doc: Open an employee's payslip for a month, side by side with another month and the difference per line.
Open the regime comparison of one employee: both regimes' computations slab by slab, from the engine.
Approve or reject a pending leave request, after the admin's spoken yes. Days beyond the balance become loss of pay in the February draft, recomputed with the engine.

args.name: amount
args.doc: The corrected amount, the bill's amount.

moves.doc: Correct a claim's amount to its bill and approve it into the February draft, after the admin's spoken yes.
Approve (into the February draft) or reject a pending claim, after the admin's spoken yes.

args.name: field
args.doc: A field of the form by its name: name, email, gender, department, title, grade, location, joined, annual_ctc, tax_regime, manager_id.

args.name: value
args.doc: As the form takes it: a location by its city, a date as 2026-02-16, CTC in rupees, regime new or old.

moves.doc: Open the new-employee form if it is not open, ring one field and set it. Refused with the field's options.
Press Save on the new-employee form after the admin's yes: the employee is added and their prorated February pay joins the draft run.
Change the regime used for an employee's TDS after the admin's yes; February TDS in the draft is recomputed for the months left.

args.name: summary
args.doc: The written summary the payroll team reads: what was asked, what was found, what is needed.

moves.doc: Open the hand-off panel with a ticket draft written out on screen. Nothing is sent.
Send the ticket draft on screen to Paynora's payroll team after the admin's yes. The page answers with the TK- number.
Open a step of the setup wizard at /welcome and ring it.

args.name: field
args.doc: A setup field by its name: company_name, legal_name, pan, tan, registered_office, pf_code, esi_code, pt_karnataka, pt_maharashtra, pay_cycle, basic_pct, hra_metro_pct, hra_non_metro_pct, lta_g5, lta_g6_up, pf_rule, esi_rule, el_per_year, cl_per_year, sl_per_year, el_carry_forward, attendance_cutoff, lop_rule.

moves.doc: Open the step that holds the field (ringing the stepper), ring the field and set it. Refused with the field names when it is not a setup field.
Load employees_import.csv on the import step: the parsed table and the validation summary.
Run the February 2026 test payroll with the engine over the imported employees and show its totals.
Finish setup after the admin's yes and open the dashboard.
Switch to the employee self-service view as that employee, on a tab.

slices.doc: the screen in front: its path and title, and the employee it is about
the setup wizard: the step in front and which fields hold something, by name

events.doc: A leave request was approved or rejected.
A claim was fixed, approved or rejected.
An employee's TDS regime was changed.
A hand-off ticket was sent to Paynora's payroll team.
The admin approved and locked a payroll run.

events.note: {by} is on the {step} step of setup
events.doc: The setup wizard moved, or a field on it was filled.
